verses.mystical_translation: Holy Presence, who shall abide in your tabernacle? who shall dwell in your holy hill?
He that walks uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the the Living Presence. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

contemplative_note: Sacredness is measured through ordinary honesty, neighbor-love, and resistance to corruption.
safety_note: This ethical portrait is aspirational, not a purity test for excluding people from community or worship.
